title: Synthara — Synthetic EHR Generation & Benchmark
summary: A hackathon benchmark pipeline that trains four generative models (Gaussian Copula, CTGAN, TVAE, and a custom tabular diffusion model) on flattened Synthea COVID-19 EHR data and compares them on realism, downstream ML utility, and privacy leakage. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer are run directly via sdv.single_table to generate three of the four synthetic datasets benchmarked.
evidence: sagemaker/train.py:94-116 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table and fits each
